title: 第17章 气运流转下注第18章 王不见王
content_zh:
;;
日暮西山，天色将暗。
而这一夜注定因为天鹏道场的突然变故，而暗流涌动。
此次进入天鹏道场帮忙的，有大半都得了无形的气运馈赠，区别只在于或多或少。
就连最后出手帮忙的曹蒹葭与张清河，都得了一丝气运馈赠。
此刻，小镇最西边府邸中。
清芷道人看向曹蒹葭，微微颔首：“你倒是运气不错，还能跟着沾点光，喝点剩汤，这倒是我没预料的。”
少女神色迷茫，不知师叔在说什么。
清芷道人也全然没有为她解释的意思。
这缕气运终究太过微渺，作用有限。
当然，有总比没有好。
她深深看向【长青山】所在，没想到此次罗浮道争的第一场竞争中，赢家居然是谢家的小子。
反倒是鱼吞舟那小子，为何没有得气运馈赠？
清芷道人眉头皱起，觉得事情不会如此简单。
她看向一旁的曹蒹葭，突然说道：
“曹师侄，等你活着离开了罗浮洞天，一步步大道登高，你就会发现，像你师叔我这样的‘好人’，你这辈子都遇不到几个。”
曹蒹葭：“……”
她就知道！
师叔绝对在时刻盯着她！
……

巷弄口，槐树下。
光头道人神色严肃，这趟果然来对了。
谁说【天鹏道场】那位将止步大宗师的？！
观此间气运升腾流转，那位腾飞之际，只怕不远了。
十年，二十年，亦或是三十年？
突然，光头道人眉头皱起，隐隐察觉到天鹏道场方向，有稍纵即逝的气运流转变迁。
不是那散落的十几道馈赠，而是一种隐晦的联系，就像有一根无形的丝线，悄然连接着两端。
这已然不是馈赠了，而是落子，扶持，下注。
其最终所落之处是在……
光头道人目光一沉。
鱼吞舟！
又是此子！
此子姓名，隐隐与此方天地格局相呼应，三年前当真只是意外步入此间，而不是他人设局？
而天鹏道场的那位都没来，就敢匆匆落子下注？
content_en:
;;
The sun sets over the western mountains and the sky is getting dark.
And this night was destined to be filled with undercurrents due to the sudden changes in Tianpeng Dojo.
Most of the people who entered Tianpeng Dojo to help this time received invisible gifts of luck. The only difference was more or less.
Even Cao Jianjia and Zhang Qinghe, who finally came to help, received a gift of luck.
At this moment, in the mansion on the far west side of the town.
Taoist Qingzhi looked at Cao Jianjia and nodded slightly: "You are lucky. You can still get some light and drink some leftover soup. I didn't expect this."
The girl looked confused and didn't know what her uncle was talking about.
Taoist Qingzhi had no intention of explaining it to her.
After all, this ray of luck is too weak and has limited effect.
Of course, something is better than nothing.
She looked deeply at the location of [Evergreen Mountain]. Unexpectedly, in the first competition of the Luofu Taoist Competition, the winner was actually a boy from the Xie family.
On the other hand, why didn't that boy Yu Tunzhou get the gift of luck?
Taoist Qingzhi frowned, feeling that things would not be so simple.
She looked at Cao Jianjia aside and suddenly said:
"Master Nephew Cao, when you leave Luofu Cave Heaven alive and climb higher step by step, you will find that there are not many 'good people' like your uncle and me in your life."
Cao Jianjia: "..."
She knew it!
Uncle Master is definitely keeping an eye on her all the time!
…
At the entrance of the alley, under the locust tree.
The bald Taoist looked serious. This trip was indeed the right one.
Who said that the one at [Tianpeng Dojo] would stop being a great master? !
Watching the fortunes rising and flowing here, I'm afraid the time for that person to take off is not far away.
Ten years, twenty years, or thirty years?
Suddenly, the bald Taoist frowned, faintly aware of a fleeting change in luck in the direction of Tianpeng Dojo.
It's not the dozens of scattered gifts, but an obscure connection, like an invisible thread that quietly connects the two ends.
This is no longer a gift, but a move, support, and a bet.
Its final resting place is...
The bald Taoist's eyes darkened.
The fish swallows the boat!
It's this guy again!
This son's name vaguely echoes the pattern of this world. Did he really just accidentally step into this place three years ago, rather than someone else setting up a trap?
And the person from Tianpeng Dojo didn't even come, so he dared to place a bet in a hurry?
